acquisition method: The Orbitrap Lumos was operated in data-dependent mode
alkylation reagent: alkylated in the dark with 14mM iodoacetamide
alkylation concentration: alkylated in the dark with 14mM iodoacetamide
cleavage agent: digested with LysC (Promega) for 2-3 hours at 37°C. Lysates were further diluted with 50mM ammonium bicarbonate to < 2M urea and digested with trypsin (Promega) at 1:50 (enzyme:protein) overnight at 37°C.
collision energy: the HCD collision energy was set at 38... the CID collision energy was set at 35... the HCD collision energy was set at 65... the HCD normalized collision energy was set at 33
enrichment method: mixed with 5mg of TiO2 beads... High Select Fe-NTA phosphopeptide enrichment kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) was used
fractionation method: Strong cation exchange (SCX), High pH Reversed-Phase
Strong cation exchange (SCX) fractionation was performed... fractionated using the Pierce High pH Reversed-Phase kit
fragmentation method: HCD MS/MS scans (R=50,000) were acquired... CID MS/MS scans (R=30,000) were acquired
instrument: The Orbitrap Lumos was operated in data-dependent mode... The Q-Exactive was operated in data-dependent mode
ionization type: equipped with an integrated electrospray emitter
labeling: Ten samples were analysed by mass spectrometry using Ten-plex Tandem Mass Tags (TMT) to quantify phosphosite intensity
reduction reagent: reduced with 5mM DTT for 30 minutes at 56°C
reduction concentration: reduced with 5mM DTT for 30 minutes at 56°C
